note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The stations are abstract and fictional, drawn at the same size on one row (no rank, level or hierarchy); the path is ONLY the sequence supplied in routes.steps; the prior-examination tray is a neutral two-slot tray at the path’s last stop, marked only by a plain tab (no criterion, threshold or gate). The two supplied states have equal weight: ● 'authorization requested' (the petition alone) and ◆ 'decision supplied' (a placeholder sheet whose content is never shown; never granted / refused / admitted). No time limit, outcome or jurisdiction is drawn. Brief fields: decisions (the petition and the supplied decision placeholder), routes, outcomes, objectLabels, actionProgress, annotations and finalState are editable; actorLabels maps to courier.label (the participant) and routes.bodies[].label (the stations). OMITTED brief field: grounds — grounds of a request would add legal content (criteria) this motif must not draw; the request and the supplied decision are placeholders only.
